Our approach generates textual descriptions of the visual observations and leverages the power of language to describe differences between images ... Instead of treating candidate images as isolated inputs and prompting LLMs to generate independent visual descriptions, we leverage VLMs to compare multiple images and generate contextualized scene descriptions that highlight each image's distinctive features.
We propose enhancing the contextual understanding of LLM-based VLN agents by generating analogical scene and spatial descriptions.

quote: Three main metrics are used to evaluate navigation performance: (1) Navigation Error (NE): the mean of the shortest path distance between the agent's final position and the goal destination. (2) Success Rate (SR): the percentage of the predicted final position being within 3 meters from the goal destination. (3) Success Rate Weighted Path Length (SPL): normalizes success rate by trajectory length.
